newsitem.title: USA: LCI Int'l says study confirms lower rates.
newsitem.headline: LCI Int'l says study confirms lower rates.

text.p: LCI International Inc said on Thursday a recent market study confirms that LCI customers have lower long-distance rates than they had with their previous cariers.
Research firm Bruskin/Goldring found that 83 percent of LCI customers say their long-distance rates are now lower. Customers also say they are saving $264 per year on their bills, LCI said.
LCI shares were off 1/2 to 20-1/2 midday on Thursday. The stock was one of the top 10 most actively traded issues on the New York Stock Exchange.

Customers said in the study that the company's practice of billing customers in six-second increments after the first 30 seconds, rather than charging for the full minute, was the top reason for selecting LCI.
LCI said it is the sixth-largest U.S. long distance carrier.
